rationale: VERSION 2.1.0 -> 2.2.0; canonical Racket rule and synchronized source records unchanged; self_check now enforces row_gap>=2 and col_gap>=2, rejecting adjacent diagonal endpoint pairs that were outside every declared normal/edge domain; added profile_signature(grid) for the complete linked five-tuple and rule_mirror(grid) for direct Python-Racket parity; added focused regressions covering all 8 canonical containers/4 unique profiles, both seed ranges, gap-0/gap-1 negatives, explicit-none equivalence, unknown modes, and the square-diagonal control; replaced broad-envelope/stale 10-seed evidence with final-hash 5000-per-band main+stability counts and the current 30-seed boundary matrix
summary: 0-background grid with exactly two color-8 endpoints (read in reading order, so the first is the topmost). The oracle draws two L-paths between them: diagonal-first (min(|dr|,|dc|) diagonal steps then ||dr|-|dc|| straight steps along the major axis) and straight-first (segments swapped). Path cells become 3, endpoints stay 8, everything else becomes 0.
